rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax as printed ('0.9%'). Row 'פיקדון לשנה': rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'צמוד למדד המחירים לצרכן', amount 'החל מ-1000 ₪', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירת הפיקדון', renewal '-' / '-', exit points 'לא קיימת' '-', common-deposit rate '-', remark '-', deposit method '-'. The table prints no deposit channel. Read 2026-11-06 from the data the page loads (https://www.bankhapoalim.co.il/forms/he/_api/deposit-products-data); the data carries no date and the page says 'המידע נכון למועד הצגתו ולפני חישוב מס רווחי הון', so effective_from is the day read.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ב); עמ' 41, סעיף 9(13)

tax_bucket.notes: Read as fully linked to the consumer price index on the 447 table's linkage column alone ('צמוד למדד המחירים לצרכן', quoted in the notes of rate_offered); no terms document of this deposit was read, so whether the linkage is full, which the bucket needs (TXI-04: a deposit counts as linked only when fully linked to the index), rests on that column. Fully linked: the linkage differentials are exempt (TXI-05) and the interest above the linkage is taxed at up to 25% (TXI-02), at a lower bracket from age 60 (TXI-19). Copied from the rule base (sources read there 2026-10-25), not re-read today. The engine reads no tax_bucket today.
